desc: The AM suppressors are made of a lightweight, high strength Titanium alloy, which is 100% CNC machined and orbital welded to minimize weight without sacrificing durability. The suppressor bore is precision machined for perfect concentricity to ensure rifle accuracy is not compromised and point of impact shift is both minimal and repeatable every time. Last but not least, for military and law enforcement customers, these suppressors are specifically engineered and tested to eliminate muzzle flash even in low light environments.
